title: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
requirement: Housing providers may not impose a blanket denial based on arrests or convictions; they must consider applicants case-by-case and may not consider non-convictions, sealed or expunged convictions, juvenile records, convictions over 5 years old, or credit scores.
key_value: conviction more than 5 years old excluded
coverage_conditions: Housing providers receiving DND funding or land, or with income-restricted units created under the BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy.

conditions.text: Only housing providers receiving DND funding or land or with BPDA Inclusionary Development Policy income-restricted units

applicability.per_tenancy: Exceptions where a conviction has a direct relationship to the housing sought or an unreasonable risk of substantial harm; does not apply to current criminal behavior.
coverage_quotes: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions.

exemptions: Federal or state criminal history requirements that conflict with this policy; convictions with a direct relationship to the housing or an unreasonable risk of harm; current criminal behavior.
citation: Boston Fair Chance Tenant Selection Policy
quoted_span: Housing providers receiving Department of Neighborhood Development (DND) funding and/or land, or that have income restricted units created under the Boston Planning and Development Agency (BPDA) Inclusionary Development Policy will not impose a blanket policy that denies housing to anyone with arrests and or convictions.
interaction: Where federal or state law imposes a conflicting criminal history requirement, that federal or state law preempts this policy.
